Name: Little Cottage Farm - 1.6 UPDATE
Author: Lavliette
Description:
Part Three of my Cottage Farm Series.
This time with a small organized farm, where one of everything should fit.

If you don't like my Waterfalls edit, just replace the images inside the folder with the original from here:
https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10964
[u]

Features[/u]
• All grass is tillable 
• Replaces the Forest Farm

[u]Requirements
[/u]• For SDV 1.6 
• Daisyniko's Tilesheets
[u]
Installation
[/u]• Install the Requirements
• Download this mod and open the .zip folder
• Put the unzipped folder [CP] Little Cottage Farm into your Mods 
• Run the game with Smapi and select the Forest Farm

Enjoy!
